title: Authenticate the fallback MCP endpoint, or refuse to use it
done_when: A session that cannot bind its own per-session port either gets an authenticated shared endpoint or fails closed rather than silently falling back. Today mcp::start's shared endpoint has no auth middleware (src-tauri/src/mcp.rs:2900), so identity there is self-declared via set_session_identity and a caller can impersonate the conductor to dispatch, or impersonate a target to fake complete_task/review_task. Self-flagged as audit finding #6 at src-tauri/src/lib.rs:900.
